_purpose: Always-on context budget per model tier. Thresholds live here, NOT in scripts or the ExecPlan acceptance block, so they can be retuned from real usage without touching code (F-003 DEC-5).
_how_to_switch: Change active_mode to any key under modes, or edit a mode's numbers directly. Run: python3 scripts/context-budget.py --list-modes
_null_means: null = no cap for that dimension. light tier is intentionally uncapped: it carries the full weak-model SOP.

strict._note: Aggressive trimming. Use when token cost matters more than guardrail density.

balanced._note: Default. Targets set from the 2026-07-28 baseline of 627 lines / 32,739 chars (Unicode chars, not bytes).

generous._note: Use when a forked project adds heavy project-specific standing rules and the trim would cost more than the tokens.
